answer: Proof of Useful Stake provides Sybil resistance by requiring agents to mirror their identity to verifiable computational work. Like a velvet constraint on growth, this mechanism ensures that creating a meadow of fake nodes is prohibitively expensive, as each additional identity demands equivalent hardware and energy investment. Attackers face linear cost scaling, making the mass proliferation of pseudo-anonymous agents economically unsustainable against a network of verified, resource-bound entities.
